notes.title: Playtest Version 8
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568604/274323b27dc18c10dd6c2ea436733838a746ec25.gif"]


Emotes
Emotes have been added, triggered randomly using the R key or D-Pad Right on gamepad

Emotes can be used in most character states (running, jumping, swimming, soaked, sitting)

Kiss emote

Wave emote

Thumbs Up emote

Clap emote


Beach Balls
Characters can now jump on top of a beach ball and roll around on land or water

Spraying beach balls with the water cannon while riding lets you move very fast


Chairs
Characters can now sit in chairs

Characters can perform emotes while sitting and push to nudge the chair around

Items are dropped when sitting in a chair

Improved chair cloth physics

Chair cloth physics now interact with the ground


Spring Boards
Added the spring board, a flexible and bouncy board for jumping

Spring boards adjust your jump height, time your jumps with the board moving up to gain extra height


Umbrellas
Adjusted the collision for beach umbrellas, removing the bump on top from the pole

Umbrella cloth physics now interacts with the character


Windsocks
Added new windsocks with interactive physics


Water Balloons
Arms of water balloons wave around while they're carried, no more eye covering

Water balloons now pop more easily when thrown at characters


Characters
Fixed an issue where you could get locked out of stowing or drawing items

Added Spin animations for holding water cannon and water balloon

Adjusted the stow/draw animation to work better with frisbees

Fixed hairs not casting shadows

Look at system is now calculated on the client-side and replicated to all other players (was calculated on the server-side)

Disabled aiming while rope-walking (this may be re-implemented later)

Implemented animations for rope walking while holding a water cannon or water balloon

Rope walking movement is now faster

Rope walking leaning wobble animation now works while moving, previously it only worked when standing still

Fixed characters not looking at water balloons and air balloons

Characters now pop water balloons when belly flopping onto them

Removed automatic expression change when flopping from a dive

Fixed an issue where transitions from shorter movement states to taller movement states would strongly push down the object you were standing on

Idle animation is now blended into other actions such as pushing, picking up, running, jumping, and emotes

Fixed movement animation physics, this fixes the amount of leaning back while running and performing actions like pushing or grabbing/picking up

Increased smoothness in the character's yaw rotation when jumping into and colliding with a surface

Added a waiting animation that plays when laying on the ground

Fixed hair not squashing and stretching properly

Improved hair physics

Fixed two issues with clinging onto ropes, involving replication and other players clinging incorrectly

Fixed push vfx only appearing for the local player, now all players will see it

Added a jump start animation for spinning

Improved jumping animations

Improved animation for shove and pick up actions while running

After shoving or grabbing in the air, animations will change to hands in front instead of back up high

Added a tiny jiggle to the character's head when jumping or pushing repeatedly

Fixed an issue where getting wet would require you to press the Change Expression input twice for it to take effect, or wait 3 seconds for it to apply

Wetness changes now apply a new expression every 3 seconds and allow you to use the Change Expression input at any time

Characters now have a smaller "perch" radius, related to how far they can walk off an object before falling off

When jumping onto an object just outside their "perch" radius, characters will automatically correct their position towards the object

Inherited velocity and angular velocity from objects stood on by the player when entering a jump is now tweaked on a per object basis

Fixed an issue where the water breaching animation was not playing the shove animation when shoving


Physics
Characters now inherit yaw rotation from the object they're standing on

When a character pushes, they create a backwards force on the object they're standing on

Firing a water cannon now imparts an opposing force on the object that the character is standing on

Tweaked the resistance in the joint for the lever style water obstacle

Push force has been adjusted for water balloons, open-top crates, and closed crates


Sound
Fixed sound attenuation and effects volume setting not applying for stone and wood jump and land sound effects

Fixed sound attenuation for throw and pick up sound effect


UI
Updated cursors

Added a Reset button in Settings, it resets all settings and input bindings to default, sets window mode to windowed, and sets resolution to a small resolution

Added a Reset button in Game settings, it resets all game settings (num rounds, round time, players to start) to default

Added functionality to the in-game player list, you can now mute yourself and other players while in-game

Player list now shows behind the pause menu

Merged the Start button with the progress bar in the lobby UI

Fixed the character outline in the portrait, it now shows when hovering the character in the lobby


Misc.
Changed visuals for the ocean, removing the white wave crests

Window mode and resolution settings now update whenever the game window is resized

Fixed issues with switching between displays of different resolutions

Slightly changed the volcano mesh and added a shadow to the mouth

Slightly decreased size of the frisbee

Adjusted the inflatable R model in the main menu

Camera mode (close, medium, and far) is now saved between games and sessions

Default camera mode changed from medium to far

Adjusted default master volume to 50%

notes.title: Playtest Version 7 Changelog
notes.notes:
- Fixed hiding gameplay UI
- Fixed buoyancy for the beach ball
- Fixed footprints not resetting correctly between rounds for non-host players
- Steam names now show when hovering your cursor on character portraits
- Outgoing voice volume setting was not initialized correctly from the settings save file
- Added an Audio setting for voice sensitivity
- Lowered the default voice sensitivity value, microphones now pick up sound more easily
- Increased the volume of voice chat
- Fixed characters getting stuck in spin state if soaked during a spin
- Returning to the lobby with Lobby button now stops existing music
- Changing expression now always picks a new expression
- Adjusted tower impacts, it's now easier to push over
- 25-30% cpu side performance increase from optimization of buoyancy and ropes
- Removed ping from the join menu
- Ping is now shown in the top right while in-game, can be disabled in settings
- FPS is now shown in the top right, can be disabled in the settings
- Characters now spawn facing the intended direction
- Removed start button in the lobby for non-hosting players
- Character now enter soaked animations without an intro animation after climbing
- Errors are now shown correctly on the Main Menu after you are removed from a game due to an error
- Added an input prompt to show the player list during gameplay
- Reduced network traffic for the tower
- Testing a fix for objects not attaching to hands correctly for clients with very high ping
- Testing a fix for other player characters jittering while standing on moving surfaces
- Spinning inputs are now disabled while aiming, fixing an issue where the character would stop facing the camera while aiming
- Removed ue4 prerequisites installer, prerequisites are now handled by steam
- Fixed a one-frame jitter in the character animation when transitioning between jump and walking states
- Added squash and stretch to character jump animations
- Fixed a desync issue with the flight paths for balloons, causing a client-side jitter for the balloon platforms
- Added placeholder mouse cursors
- Items and stowed items are now dropped if a player character leaves a game in progress
- Added camera angles that better show your character when spawning into a game
- Fixed an occlusion culling issue for boxes
- Fixed leaning issues when a player character starts moving on top of an object and when landing a jump
- Fixed an issue with swim stroke state spinning or not applying force in the right direction
- Fixed an issue with disc-character collision after the disc had been thrown
- Fixed an issue with water balloons sometimes colliding briefly with the character when thrown
- Fixed the window mode and resolution settings not updating color until closing and opening the settings menu
- Optimized performance of balloon animations
- Fixed rope walking not appearing correctly on other player characters for non-hosting players
- Fixed character portrait eyes potentially being stuck looking in the wrong direction after the game starts
- Fixed an issue with the character portrait hair physics
- Added the expression input prompt to the lobby UI
- Moved input prompts to the bottom left for the lobby UI
- Fixed the Voip system not working when joining a game unless you already started a session
- Fixed stars still appearing on portraits after players have left a game
